Why does the hospital always call people to mow the lawn on Saturday and Sunday mornings? Even after working late, we have to listen to the sound of the lawn mowing in the morning. text: It's very difficult to contact them. I called and no one answered. It's worse than the big Hua Hin hospital.

I'd say anyone entering should dress well because they judge you by your attire. The staff, nurses, and even the security guards have double standards. I'm a painting contractor working in Hua Hin, and my sibling had a fever, so we took them to Hua Hin Hospital. We waited for almost half a day but didn't receive treatment because they told us to go to a larger hospital. We knew we'd have to pay for treatment outside our area because we didn't have any insurance. The nurse at the counter asked, "Do you have money? You don't have social security, do you have money to pay?" If we didn't have money, why did we even go there? It was a bit upsetting, but I'll remember this lesson. It's better to go to a larger hospital if you need anything.
